title: Settlement Desk Rules: Net Energy Metering True-Up and Termination Settlements
content:
These rules govern the settlement of the credit bank of a Net Energy Metering agreement at the annual true-up and at termination.

## Rules in force

1. **When the bank is settled.** At the bill dated in the true-up month, and when the agreement terminates, the residual bank is settled.
2. **Residual bank.** The residual bank at a settlement is the credit bank balance after every export credit and every credit application dated on or before the settlement date, including credit applied on bills dated that day.
3. **Method of payment.** A payout of at least the rider's check minimum is paid by check; a smaller payout is credited to the service agreement.
4. **Nothing to settle.** A residual of zero settles nothing.
5. **Once only, and only for these statuses.** Each settlement date and kind is settled once, and a settlement is booked only for an agreement in operating or terminated status.

The check minimum is the rider's figure in its true-up terms. Whether a settlement of the same date and kind already exists, and the agreement's status, are read from the company's records before a settlement is booked.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current settlement basis:

- the clause providing that at an anniversary true-up cash out pays the residual, carry forward leaves it in the bank, and forfeit zeroes it;
- the clause providing that at termination the residual is settled under the rider's termination disposition.

## Method of payment at the check minimum (hypothetical)

Hypothetical inputs: a rider whose check minimum is 25.00.

| Payout | Paid by |
|---|---|
| 24.99 | Credit to the service agreement |
| 25.00 | Check |
| 130.40 | Check |

## Status of the agreement

| Agreement status | Settlement may be booked |
|---|---|
| Operating | Yes |
| Terminated | Yes |
| Applied, approved, rejected, withdrawn or expired | No |

superseded_clauses: At an anniversary true-up, cash_out pays the residual, carry_forward leaves it in the bank, and forfeit zeroes it.
At termination the residual is settled under termination_disposition.
